assumptions.factor_selection_note: Factor selection: VW All; no tail factor.
assumptions.validation_note: Source is fully synthetic (seed=42). Validation disabled for synthetic teaching data.
assumptions.age_convention: triangle.development_ages starts at 0 (first observation); ATA/ATU/LDF matrices start at age 1 (no age-0 column: there is no transition into age 0). ATA column dev_j = cumulative[j]/cumulative[j-1] (factor into age j). ATU[dev_j] applied to a value observed at age j-1. Oldest accident period: applied_atu_period=null, ATU=1.0 (fully developed).
